frozen_before: any model in this study was fitted or scored
market_family: MLB full-game lines: winner, run difference, total runs; regular season 2022-2026
prediction_cutoff: first pitch; features use games that ended strictly before it (99.4% final by T-90m)
labels: final score from the certified dataset. The MLB Kalshi official archive (1.2 GB) was not joined in this study; contract-level scoring is deferred
baseline: season_state = walk-forward ridge on wins, losses, run differential, games played/remaining; climatology = expanding mean

hypotheses.claim: adding mlb.pythag_luck to the season-state reference lowers out-of-sample squared error of margin
adding mlb.pythag_luck to the season-state reference lowers out-of-sample squared error of total
adding run_form_uncatalogued to the season-state reference lowers out-of-sample squared error of margin
adding run_form_uncatalogued to the season-state reference lowers out-of-sample squared error of total

multiple_testing: Holm across 4 hypotheses on the single TEST season 2025 (alpha 0.05). One test season cannot satisfy the leave-one-season-out rule in a meaningful way: any result here is at most suggestive
not_claimed: no market comparison, no starter or lineup information: this is a floor for team-only inputs, not a usable MLB model
holdout_rule: 2026 outcomes are blanked before any fit unless --holdout; one-shot
